answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 13 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 460 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. A karst that can be verified, a ocean that can be measured, and a violet that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
